head: simzy39:fix/vulkan-allocation-contracts
title: Respect Vulkan allocation limits and preserve fallback error causes
body:
Fixes https://github.com/Traverse-Research/gpu-allocator/issues/326; addresses this allocator's portion of #125.

Cap every native block to its selected heap, reject impossible requests before the driver call, guard owned allocation count, and try compatible types once in preference order only after recoverable failures. Preserve fatal allocation/mapping errors. Exclude AMD device-coherent types because device feature enablement is unavailable. Publish a new block only after its first suballocation succeeds.

Independent of #323: existing sizing threshold, growth and empty-cache policy remain in place. External native allocations still require caller coordination for the device-wide count limit.

Validation: ten public-constructor driver-stub tests pass (nine fail against main); strict std/no_std Clippy, formatting, Rust 1.71 std and Rust 1.81 no_std consumer builds pass. Normal failed-map cleanup already existed; null-success handling is defensive.

AI disclosure: an OpenAI coding agent implemented, tested and wrote this description at the contributor's explicit direction.
